notes: Built for a big warehouse: load-tested at ten times a real prospect's volume and tuned to match. New in Settings: Health (disk, backups, background work, slow pages), nightly Backups with off-site copies and weekly restore drills, and Webhooks. Rate limits, address blocking, scoped API keys and a sealed audit trail. On the floor: scanners keep working when the Wi-Fi drops, and the pick queue shows who is already picking an order.
